text.zh-TW: 確認司機姓名、電話與聯絡方式（WhatsApp／LINE）、車型與座位數
text.en: Confirm the driver's name, phone and chat app (WhatsApp/LINE), car model and seats

text.zh-TW: 確認每日包車費含什麼：油錢、過路費、停車、司機餐宿
text.en: Confirm what the daily rate includes: fuel, tolls, parking, the driver's meals and room

text.zh-TW: 確認每日包車時數、超時費與跨區加價
text.en: Confirm the daily hours, overtime and out-of-area charges

text.zh-TW: 確認每天的接送點與時間（就是當天第一與最後一個行程點）
text.en: Confirm each day's pick-up and drop-off place and time (the day's first and last stop)

text.zh-TW: 確認等待時間上限（逛景點時司機等多久）
text.en: Confirm how long the driver will wait at each stop

text.zh-TW: 確認當地小費行情，由誰給、從公基金出還是各自出
text.en: Confirm the local tipping custom and whether tips come from the pool

text.zh-TW: 確認付款方式（多半現金）與幣別、要準備多少小鈔
text.en: Confirm how to pay (often cash), the currency, and how many small notes to carry

text.zh-TW: 確認要去的寺廟或宗教場所的服裝規範
text.en: Confirm the dress code of temples or religious sites on the route
